case.title: The Train Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Continental Express, the evening turned dark. The swap of a famous painting with a fake one has shocked everyone here. The doors are locked, and no one is allowed to leave until the truth comes out. 6 guests are still inside, and every one of them is hiding something. You can search rooms like The Grand Lobby, The Lounge, and The Private Study to find clues. You can talk to each guest to hear their story. But be careful: one guest is not who they say they are. They are using a fake name to hide the truth. Your job is to find that person before they slip away into the night.
case.crime: The swap of a famous painting with a fake one
case.target_fake_identity: Rowan Vance, a retired government worker people trust
case.escape_plan: Rowan Vance plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a retired government worker
solution.reasoning: Rowan Vance is the hidden person. The main clues (a photo, a wine glass) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.
